title: CMMC Now Decides What You Can Bid
summary: CMMC has moved from compliance roadmap to bid qualification. For Los Angeles defense suppliers, scope decisions and evidence decide what you can still bid.
caption:
Ask a defense subcontractor what CMMC costs and you get a tooling estimate. Ask what it costs to fail one and the honest answer is the contract.

CMMC has moved out of the compliance roadmap and into the bid qualification. The companies that struggle with it rarely struggle on technology. They struggle on boundary and evidence.

Three things executives in the Southern California defense supply chain underestimate: scope is the only real cost lever, the annual affirmation carries a named human's signature, and generative AI tools have quietly become external service providers inside boundaries nobody redrew.

The essay works through what a Los Angeles supplier should decide before the next solicitation arrives.
